EmailTemplate.description: Outgoing Approval Request - Notify Owner of Approval
EmailTemplate.name: Outgoing Approval Request - Notify Owner of Approval
EmailTemplate.subject: Approval Granted: {!Opportunity.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Opportunity.OwnerFirstName},
Congrats, your Outgoing Referral {!Opportunity.Name} request has been APPROVED.
Your referral will be handed off to Workday within the next 1 – 2 business days. To check the status of your referral, please view the "Outgoing Opportunity – Open and Shared" opportunity list in Salesforce. Your referral will appear in this list once it has been sent to Workday.
